name: aris-code-bridge
description: Connects this editor to the Aris desktop app.

aris.welcomeAdopted.description: Set once SomniQ has replaced the editor's own welcome page. Kept in settings rather than extension state so that resetting the profile brings SomniQ's first run back instead of VSCodium's.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with SomniQ Code
walkthroughs.description: The editor is wired into the rest of SomniQ. Here is what that buys you.

steps.title: This is your project folder
steps.description:
The editor opens the SomniQ project you have selected, so the assistant and this editor are always looking at the same files on disk.
[Open the explorer](command:workbench.view.explorer)

steps.title: Ask about a selection
steps.description:
Select code, then press Ctrl+Alt+A (or right-click → Ask Aris). The selection is dropped into the chat composer with its file and line range — nothing is sent until you add your question and hit send.
[Try it](command:aris.askAris)

steps.title: Run notebooks
steps.description:
Python and Jupyter are installed for you. Open any .ipynb and run cells as usual.
[Create a notebook](command:ipynb.newUntitledIpynb)

steps.title: Install what you are missing
steps.description:
The marketplace is Open VSX. Most language servers, formatters and themes are there.
[Browse extensions](command:workbench.view.extensions)
